name: arxiv-digest
author: sparkleware
description: Daily digest of newest AI / autonomous-agent papers on arXiv — top submissions in cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.MA. No API key required.
long_description_md:
## What it does

Queries the arXiv API daily for the latest submissions across the three subject classes most relevant to autonomous AI agents (`cs.AI`, `cs.LG`, `cs.MA`), de-duplicates, and prints title + authors + abstract snippet for the top 10. Optional `${var}` filters the query to a topic (e.g. `${var}="reinforcement learning"`).

## Why

Keeping up with AI / agent research is a full-time job. This skill compresses it into one terminal-sized digest per morning — scan in 30 seconds, decide what to actually open.

## How it works

Fetches arXiv's Atom feed via `curl`, parses with `xmllint --xpath` (preferred) or an awk fallback if xmllint isn't installed. Optionally logs the digest to `memory/logs/arxiv-digest-<date>.md` so you can grep your history later.

No authentication, no API key, no rate-limit risk at daily cadence.
